## Cost and allocation assessment

At parallel_sync.rs:45 the available version value is borrowed. A successful policy call does not clone ArtifactModelVersions, producer descriptions, minimum-consumer metadata or the named-model vector. The helper examines only explicit AGP text and the producer's signed numeric tuple. Its three range boundaries are fixed-size scalar AgpVersion values (48–60); PreviewKind and the version tuple are Copy/Ord values. Range comparisons use constant scalar work. There is no regex compilation, lazy initialization, model/tree traversal, filesystem read, Gradle request, task scheduling, locking, executor creation, UI callback or model mutation.

The parser checks str.len() at75–80 before delimiter scanning or debug formatting. Rust str.len() reads the stored byte length; for an already-owned arbitrarily long AGP string it does not traverse its contents. Oversized input produces a fixed literal error diagnostic and does not copy the supplied AGP text. For inputs within64 bytes, split/strip_prefix/ASCII-digit validation and three scalar i32 parses operate on borrowed substrings. They do not collect an attacker-sized Vec, create a regex, clone the input or sort anything. The successful parse constructs only its fixed-size numeric/preview result. Its work is O(L) for L<=64 and therefore bounded per policy call independently of module count. Calling the policy once for each of M modules would add O(M) feature-check work; no such caller or scheduler is introduced here.

Errors for malformed/unsupported bounded text do allocate an owned detail string, using debug formatting of at most64 input bytes (82–86/121–124). UTF-8/control escaping can expand the text, but the bound remains a constant multiple of64 plus fixed prefixes. The test's <200 assertion applies to the oversized fixed-message path, not an asserted universal <200-byte bound for every malformed input.

## Valid grammar is preserved by the input bound

Read the exact pinned AgpVersion.kt grammar and integer conversion at171–241. Successful decimal components are nonnegative signed Int values without leading zeros: at most10 digits each. Three components and two dots occupy at most32 bytes. The longest valid suffix is -alpha plus two preview digits (8 bytes), giving a maximum valid spelling of40 bytes. The64-byte check therefore rejects no spelling that can successfully parse under this pinned grammar. This is a static width calculation, not a benchmark or a claim about every string matched by the preliminary regex before its numeric conversion.

Historical zero-padding checks and ALPHA<BETA<RC<DEV<stable order use bounded scalar logic, retaining the referenced comparison meaning. BasicModules.kt:75–81 defines model>=8.0 and the same exact legacy AGP intervals used by this policy. Valid explicit AGP is checked before model-version override; avoiding a malformed input cannot change the feature result. Minimum-consumer absence remains irrelevant to this one helper as in the original reference.

## Existing error helper boundary — nonblocking scope limitation

CapturedField::available in the already reviewed/imported generated_artifacts.rs:137–149 formats an unavailable capability/detail or copies a notApplicable detail. That inherited path has O(C+D) work/allocation in the supplied diagnostic lengths. The new64-byte bound applies to explicit AGP parsing, not arbitrary getter diagnostic payloads or preexisting captured-string storage. Reusing this helper preserves the required typed diagnostic contract and is explicitly within task scope; it is not a new parser regression or a blocker. Do not describe the entire public Result/error API as allocation-free or as a hard total-memory bound. If a future hot caller repeatedly formats unusually large unavailable diagnostics, cache the result at publication or apply a separately justified diagnostic policy, while preserving useful error information.

## Coverage and execution limits

Inspected all10 declared tests. The selected original checkSupportsParallelSync preserves its nine literal assertions, original Int.MIN_VALUE major/minor, empty description and original named assertion meaning. The unchanged original ModelVersionsTest.kt remains hash-identical. Additional checks cover all100 valid7.3.0 alpha suffixes, boundaries, signed model overrides/descriptions, malformed/unknown AGP precedence, historical spelling and integer bounds. The100,000-character malformed-input case at tests:228–234 asserts the fixed short diagnostic and no echoed input. It tests observable error behavior; it has not been run in this review and is not a wall-time/RSS measurement. Its own fixture allocation occurs before invoking the borrowed policy and is not evidence of the parser's internal memory use.

Owner normal Rust tests, strict repository Clippy/format/library build and source-bound exact reference capture still require the lead's execution lease. If timing/RSS measurements are subsequently reported, retain the exact executed process-measurement harness source and identify workload, source, ELF, launch/I/O/fixture overhead and process scope. A eligibility bool alone establishes neither actual concurrent Gradle sync nor any concurrency performance improvement.

This reviewer ran no Cargo, rustc, Gradle, app, runtime probe, benchmark or cache mutation, and spawned no subagent. Prior reports/guards and Root's corrected V2 sources were retained. No canonical matrix or protected branch was edited. Suggested .rules additions: none.
